metadata.informationCutoffConfidence: reconstructed; original combine measurement timestamps unavailable
metadata.poolDefinition: Recorded combine participants only; not a complete draft-eligible population
metadata.poolWarning: Only 2026 combine rows are playable. Non-combine eligible and undrafted players are not represented; do not interpret as a complete scouting pool.
missingFields: individual name/school reconciliation to 2026 official invitee roster
metadata.orderVerification: nflverse trade reversal compared with NFL Operations April 22 primary order; 113 rows differed before applying the primary order.
metadata.orderWarning: Owners are the NFL Football Operations primary order as of April 22; trade-data mismatches are retained in audit metadata.
metadata.compensatoryClassification: Exact compensatory flags from official order sources for 2020, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026; unknown for 2019 and 2021.
metadata.attribution: Factual data from nflverse (combine, draft selections, games) and nflverse/nfldata (transactions); official NFL/Raiders pages used for source checks. No logos or photos used.
metadata.referenceIsolation: actualPicks and post-cutoff games are historical references only; neither is included in prospect features
metadata.officialInviteeAudit: NFL source reports 319 invitees; nflverse has 319 combine rows. Counts agree, but individual name/school matches are not stored.
